posts.t:
Things are so bad that a Penguins coach finally decided to play Sidney Crosby and Evgeni Malkin together at even-strength (hallelujah) 

In 6:42 together they were 74.50 xGF%

Perhaps the coaching staff's biggest failure so far this season is not getting close to the tangible results they should be getting out of Kindel based on how good he looks.

Put him with Malkin , Novak hasn't done anything as a top 6 center this year
